description: Riverside County Assessor-County Clerk-Recorder: the free CREST assessor tables on the county Open Data Portal. The full secured roll with owners is a paid product (see docs/registry/sources/ca-riverside-assessor.md).

sources.publisher: Riverside County Assessor-County Clerk-Recorder (published by RCIT GIS)
sources.license: Item license text "Public Use" (ArcGIS item licenseInfo; no named open-data license). Data Distribution Disclaimer on gis.rivco.org: for reference only, no warranty
sources.ai_use: Not addressed on the open-data portal. The assessor's own site (rivcoacr.org) robots.txt disallows a list of named AI crawlers
sources.redistribution: Not stated; "Public Use" is undefined. The paid ACR bulk files carry a separate Data Distribution Agreement that was not read (it sits under a robots-disallowed path). Robert decided on 2026-11-06 that cited commercial facts from this public file may be kept. The publisher's own text is unchanged and still does not grant redistribution. See docs/registry/decisions/2026-11-06-cited-facts.md.
sources.notes: Two tables, joined on PIN: CREST_GENERAL (layer 70: class description, situs, business use) and CREST_TAXYEAR (layer 100: land and structure values, tax year 2027). No owner names: the county publishes owners only in the paid files. Download is the Hub CSV export (layers=<service layer id>). The Hub robots.txt sets Crawl-delay: 60, which the collector honours. Assessor table CREST_PROPERTY_CHAR (layer 80, year built and areas) is served by the REST service but not published as a Hub item, so it is not fetched. NOT YET DOWNLOADED: the Hub CSV export streams very slowly (about 14 MB received then stalled) and the cached export carries Last-Modified 2025-11-18, older than the live layer (live CREST_TAXYEAR holds tax year 2027, 1,013,208 rows; CREST_GENERAL 1,124,758 rows), so a refreshed export or paged REST queries (2,000 rows per request, no subquery support) may be needed. Verified stays false until a download completes and the terms are confirmed by a person.
